svg.title: Two-channel raw ADC logical wiring
svg.desc: Board 3V3 feeds two independent resistor dividers. GPIO36 uses 10k over 10k; GPIO34 uses 20k over 10k; each node has 100 nF to common ground. No sensors, loads or external supply.

g.text: No sensors • No OLED • No power/energy calculation
Logical overview, not measured results or a tested build.
See wiring for 1% resistors, node capacitors and input bounds.
